column1: # The rows of the inventory (corpus/inventory) compared by eye with Pages,
# Numbers and Keynote 15.4 on the owner's Mac, with the date. verdict is
# "same" when Desk does what iWork 15.4 does, "by decision" when Desk does
# it in another form that a decision sets (the decision is in the note),
# "gap" when iWork 15.4 has something Desk lacks (the backlog item is in
# the note), "moved" for a row the owner moved to a later phase (the
# backlog item is in the note), and "not finished" for a row Desk has not
# finished yet, where the row records what iWork 15.4 does for the second
# round. The captures stay outside the repository (D-011).
